sentences.pt: Era quinta-feira à tarde, véspera de um feriado prolongado, e o escritório já estava quase vazio.
sentences.en: It was Thursday afternoon, the eve of a long holiday weekend, and the office was already almost empty.

sentences.pt: Larissa estava prestes a fechar o computador quando o chefe a chamou na sala dele.
sentences.en: Larissa was about to close her computer when her boss called her into his office.

sentences.pt: "O cliente antecipou a data-limite", disse ele, sem olhar para ela.
sentences.en: "The client moved the deadline forward," he said, without looking at her.

sentences.pt: "O relatório que era para o dia vinte agora tem que estar pronto na segunda de manhã."
sentences.en: "The report that was due on the twentieth now has to be ready Monday morning."

sentences.pt: Larissa sentiu um frio na barriga.
sentences.en: Larissa felt a knot in her stomach.

sentences.pt: Ela esperava aquele fim de semana fazia meses.
sentences.en: She had been looking forward to that weekend for months.

sentences.pt: Iria para Paraty com o namorado, Felipe, e já tinham pago o hotel de antemão.
sentences.en: She was going to go to Paraty with her boyfriend, Felipe, and they had already paid for the hotel in advance.

sentences.pt: "Não dá para dividir o trabalho com outra pessoa?", perguntou ela.
sentences.en: "Can't the work be split with someone else?" she asked.

sentences.pt: "Todo mundo já saiu. Sinto muito", respondeu ele.
sentences.en: "Everyone has already left. I'm sorry," he answered.

sentences.pt: Larissa pensou em dizer não, mas sabia que isso poderia custar caro no fim do ano.
sentences.en: Larissa thought about saying no, but knew it could cost her dearly at the end of the year.

sentences.pt: Naquela noite, ela ligou para Felipe e explicou tudo.
sentences.en: That night, she called Felipe and explained everything.

sentences.pt: Ele ficou decepcionado, mas logo pensou numa saída.
sentences.en: He was disappointed, but soon thought of a way out.

sentences.pt: "Leva o computador. Você trabalha de manhã, e à tarde a gente aproveita a cidade."
sentences.en: "Bring the computer. You work in the morning, and in the afternoon we enjoy the town."

sentences.pt: "Ninguém precisa saber de onde você está trabalhando."
sentences.en: "Nobody needs to know where you're working from."

sentences.pt: Larissa duvidou que fosse dar certo, mas não via nada melhor.
sentences.en: Larissa doubted it would work out, but she couldn't see anything better.

sentences.pt: Na sexta-feira, acordou às seis e trabalhou até o meio-dia no jardim do hotel.
sentences.en: On Friday, she woke up at six and worked until noon in the hotel garden.

sentences.pt: Mal fechava o computador, Felipe já estava na porta, pronto para sair.
sentences.en: As soon as she closed the computer, Felipe was already at the door, ready to go out.

sentences.pt: À tarde, andavam pelas ruas de pedra do centro histórico, sem relógio e sem pressa.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, they walked through the stone streets of the historic center, without a watch and without hurrying.

sentences.pt: Gradualmente, ela percebeu que trabalhava melhor ali do que no escritório.
sentences.en: Gradually, she realized that she worked better there than at the office.

sentences.pt: Ninguém a interrompia, e a brisa do mar ajudava a pensar.
sentences.en: Nobody interrupted her, and the sea breeze helped her think.

sentences.pt: No domingo à noite, o relatório estava pronto, um dia antes do prazo final.
sentences.en: On Sunday night, the report was ready, a day before the final deadline.

sentences.pt: Tinha sido um fim de semana de muito trabalho, mas também um dos mais bonitos do ano.
sentences.en: It had been a weekend of hard work, but also one of the most beautiful of the year.

sentences.pt: Ela o enviou prontamente e ainda teve tempo de jantar com Felipe à beira do mar.
sentences.en: She sent it promptly and still had time to have dinner with Felipe by the sea.

sentences.pt: Na terça-feira, o chefe ressaltou a pontualidade dela na frente de toda a equipe.
sentences.en: On Tuesday, the boss highlighted her punctuality in front of the whole team.

sentences.pt: Larissa agradeceu, mas aproveitou o momento para pedir uma coisa.
sentences.en: Larissa thanked him, but took the opportunity to ask for something.

sentences.pt: "De agora em diante, eu gostaria de trabalhar de casa vez ou outra, sobretudo nas sextas-feiras."
sentences.en: "From now on, I'd like to work from home every now and then, especially on Fridays."

sentences.pt: O chefe ficou surpreso, mas, depois de pensar um instante, concordou em tentar durante três meses.
sentences.en: The boss was surprised, but, after thinking for a moment, agreed to try it for three months.

sentences.pt: Às vezes, um problema de última hora é o que nos faz mudar o cotidiano.
sentences.en: Sometimes, a last-minute problem is what makes us change our daily routine.

sentences.pt: No alto da igreja principal de uma cidade pequena de Minas Gerais, há um relógio de quase cem anos.
sentences.en: At the top of the main church in a small town in Minas Gerais, there is a clock almost a hundred years old.

sentences.pt: Outrora, era ele que dizia a todos a hora da igreja, da feira, da escola e do almoço.
sentences.en: In the old days, it was what told everyone the time for church, the market, school and lunch.

sentences.pt: Mas, numa madrugada de inverno, o relógio parou às três e quinze e não andou mais.
sentences.en: But, in the early hours of a winter morning, the clock stopped at a quarter past three and didn't move again.

sentences.pt: Na época, quase ninguém percebeu.
sentences.en: At the time, almost nobody noticed.

sentences.pt: Os mais velhos reclamaram durante uma semana e depois esqueceram.
sentences.en: The older people complained for a week and then forgot.

sentences.pt: Afinal, todo mundo tem a hora certa no celular.
sentences.en: After all, everyone has the right time on their phone.

sentences.pt: Foi Sofia, uma menina de dez anos, quem fez a pergunta que ninguém tinha feito.
sentences.en: It was Sofia, a ten-year-old girl, who asked the question no one had asked.

sentences.pt: "Por que o relógio da igreja está sempre na mesma hora?", perguntou ela ao avô, Seu Antônio.
sentences.en: "Why is the church clock always at the same time?" she asked her grandfather, Mr. Antônio.

sentences.pt: O avô riu, mas a pergunta ficou com ele durante dias.
sentences.en: Her grandfather laughed, but the question stayed with him for days.

sentences.pt: Na juventude, ele tinha ajudado o antigo responsável a cuidar do relógio.
sentences.en: In his youth, he had helped the old caretaker look after the clock.

sentences.pt: Ainda lembrava de cada peça lá no alto da igreja.
sentences.en: He still remembered every part up there at the top of the church.

sentences.pt: Ele foi à prefeitura e perguntou se poderia tentar consertar o relógio.
sentences.en: He went to the city hall and asked if he could try to fix the clock.

sentences.pt: O secretário responsável disse que, anteriormente, um engenheiro de Belo Horizonte já tinha feito um orçamento.
sentences.en: The secretary in charge said that, previously, an engineer from Belo Horizonte had already made an estimate.

sentences.pt: O preço era alto demais para o município, e o projeto tinha sido adiado sem data.
sentences.en: The price was too high for the town, and the project had been postponed indefinitely.

sentences.pt: Seu Antônio ofereceu o próprio tempo, sem cobrar nada, contanto que a prefeitura pagasse as peças.
sentences.en: Mr. Antônio offered his own time, without charging anything, as long as the city hall paid for the parts.

sentences.pt: A licença foi dada de forma provisória, com vigência de seis meses.
sentences.en: The permit was granted on a provisional basis, valid for six months.

sentences.pt: Todos os sábados, ele subia a escada estreita da igreja, e Sofia ia junto.
sentences.en: Every Saturday, he climbed the church's narrow staircase, and Sofia went along.

sentences.pt: Simultaneamente, ele limpava as peças e explicava para a neta o que cada uma fazia.
sentences.en: At the same time, he cleaned the parts and explained to his granddaughter what each one did.

sentences.pt: O trabalho seguia devagar, em etapas, e vez ou outra parecia não ter fim.
sentences.en: The work went on slowly, in stages, and every now and then it seemed endless.

sentences.pt: Em abril, faltava apenas uma peça, que precisou ser feita por um senhor da zona rural.
sentences.en: In April, only one part was missing, which had to be made by an old man from the countryside.

sentences.pt: Finalmente, num domingo de manhã, o relógio voltou a andar.
sentences.en: Finally, on a Sunday morning, the clock started running again.

sentences.pt: Quando o relógio tocou ao meio-dia, as pessoas saíram das casas e olharam para o alto, surpresas.
sentences.en: When the clock struck noon, people came out of their houses and looked up, surprised.

sentences.pt: Algumas choraram, pois não ouviam aquele relógio havia mais de oito anos.
sentences.en: Some cried, because they hadn't heard that clock for more than eight years.

sentences.pt: Posteriormente, a prefeitura deu à praça o nome de Seu Antônio.
sentences.en: Later, the city hall named the square after Mr. Antônio.

sentences.pt: Hoje, Sofia tem vinte anos e é ela quem sobe a escada todos os sábados.
sentences.en: Today, Sofia is twenty and she is the one who climbs the stairs every Saturday.

sentences.pt: O tempo passa de qualquer forma, mas há quem cuide para que ele seja ouvido.
sentences.en: Time passes anyway, but there are those who make sure it is heard.
